intro.text: KeyDevs Technologies Limited ("KeyDevs", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect when you use our website or contact us, how we use it, who we share it with and the choices you have. By using our website you agree to the practices described here.

body.text: We collect information in the following ways:

items: Contact details such as your name, email address, phone number and company name when you fill in a form, request a quote, schedule a meeting, ask for a call back or use our cost calculator.
Project details you share, including your budget range, requirements and any files you attach.
Messages and feedback you send us by email, phone or WhatsApp.
Technical data such as your IP address, browser type, device, pages viewed and referring website.
Cookies and similar technologies, described in the Cookies section below.
Respond to your enquiries and prepare proposals and estimates.
Provide, manage and improve our services and this website.
Send updates or marketing about our services, where the law allows and you have not opted out.
Protect our website, prevent spam and fraud, and comply with legal obligations.

body.text: Cookies are small files stored on your device. We use them to make the website work, remember your choices (such as closing the cookie notice) and understand how the site is used. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, but some parts of the site may not work properly without them.
Some features, such as spam protection on forms or embedded maps and social feeds, are provided by third parties who may set their own cookies under their own policies.
We do not sell your personal information. We may share it with:

items: Service providers that help us run our website, email, hosting, analytics and customer-relationship tools, under appropriate confidentiality terms.
Companies in our group and our offices in Pakistan, the United Kingdom and India, so that the right team can respond to you.
Authorities or advisers when required by law or to protect our rights.

body.text: Because we operate in more than one country, your information may be processed outside the country where you live. Where we do this, we take steps to protect it in line with this policy and applicable law.

We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes described here, including to meet legal, accounting or reporting requirements. When it is no longer needed we delete or anonymise it.

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information against loss, misuse and unauthorised access. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:

items: Ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
Ask us to correct or delete your information.
Object to or restrict certain uses, or withdraw consent where we rely on it.
Opt out of marketing emails at any time using the link in the email.

body.text: To use any of these rights, contact us using the details below.

Our website and services are intended for businesses and adults. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has given us information, please contact us and we will delete it.
Our website may link to other websites, such as social networks and review platforms. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices, so please read their policies.
We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page with its updated date. Please check back periodically.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.text: Questions about this policy or your personal information? Email us and we will get back to you.
